title: The vs-reference regression, diagnosed and closed (Wave Q)
startedFrom: PR-48 shipped with an open regression: orchestral-midi playabilityErrors 0 -> 62, aggregate 0 -> 6.89.

diagnosis.assumedCause: excess polyphony after the per-instrument merge
diagnosis.actualCause: impossible_leap on the bass track — 21-semitone leaps against a 12-semitone bass limit
diagnosis.howItWasFound: A probe dumped the bass notes under 5 seconds on both paths: 0.78s went from pitch 42 to pitch 54. Not polyphony at all.
diagnosis.note: Two earlier fixes aimed at polyphony (a per-part ceiling, then a post-merge ceiling) changed nothing, because nothing was over the polyphony ceiling. The probe was what ended the guessing.

rootCauses.bug: A hi-hat at MIDI 42 was treated as a unison with a bass note at MIDI 42, so avoidSiblingCollisions shoved the bass note up an octave to 54 — tearing the line and creating the 21-semitone leap.
rootCauses.why: A percussion 'pitch' is a mapping to a drum, not a note. It cannot be in unison with anything.
rootCauses.fix: avoidSiblingCollisions excludes percussion on both sides: a percussion part has nothing to collide with, and percussion siblings are not collision candidates.

rootCauses.bug: The percussion exclusion did not fire, because the pattern was /\b(drum|kick|...)\b/ and the instrument is named "drums".
rootCauses.why: \bdrum\b does not match "drums". One missing plural silently disabled the whole guard.
rootCauses.fix: Substring matching instead of word-boundary matching, in both the percussion pattern and the harmony-bed instrument pattern. "strings", "drums" and "keys" are how instruments are actually named.

rootCauses.bug: yieldToVocal drops a crowding note an octave per note, which can tear a line: drop one note of a stepwise line and leave its neighbours, and the line now leaps an octave.
rootCauses.why: Staying out of the singer's way is never worth breaking the line.
rootCauses.fix: A drop that would create a leap beyond the instrument's maxLeap against an immediate melodic neighbour is refused; the note ducks by velocity instead. The pass reports how many moves it refused for this reason.

beforeThisFix.summary: CONTEXT_AWARE_ARRANGER regresses playabilityErrors — do not promote

afterThisFix.summary: CONTEXT_AWARE_ARRANGER is not measurably better — do not promote

measurementBeforeAndAfter.whatChanged: The regression is gone: every case is now at playability 0, the same as the baseline. The verdict moved from 'regresses' to 'not measurably better'.

verdict.reason: The context passes are now safe, but not better. The flag stays off. The recommendation is unchanged: get the real corpus before turning it on.

honestLimits: This closes a regression; it does not produce an improvement. criticScore moved 74.56 -> 73.78, which is inside tolerance and is not a win.
The style grammar slot is still empty on this path, so the groove pass never ran. Wiring it is the next step, and is where an improvement would plausibly come from.
Still the synthesised corpus. Still no human has judged a blind pair.
